The houses were made up of sun-dried bricks.streets were fairly wide having a width
between 10-30 feet. Beneath the streets were many small drains that carried waste and
sewerage towards the major drains out of the city. There were two very important
buildings found in the Indus Valley, the granary and a public bath.

area on a mound present in

Inform your students that the only way to investigate the Indus valley civilization is
to use archaeological data. It has evidence of that era's culture, art, and
architecture. Since no written evidence was available, it became the primary source.
